tex_content.html:
Corollary

↗ prop:scalar-product-orthonormal-basis

1. ch2:2.64

If $(V,q)$ is an $n$-dimensional scalar product space, some basis $(\beta ^i)$ of $V^*$ and nonnegative integers $r,s$ with $r+s=n$ satisfy \begin{equation} q=(\beta ^1)^2+\cdots +(\beta ^r)^2 -(\beta ^{r+1})^2-\cdots -(\beta ^{r+s})^2. \tag {2.23} \end{equation}

Proof

↗ prop:scalar-product-orthonormal-basis \sketch For an orthonormal basis $(b_i)$ with dual basis $(\beta ^i)$,

\[ q=\sum _iq(b_i,b_i)(\beta ^i)^2, \qquad q(b_i,b_i)\in \{ 1,-1\} . \]

Reorder the positive entries first; their counts $r,s$ sum to $n$.

□
